decisions.reason: The distributed airfield lighting control unit extends the firm's core airfield guidance offer and was launched only recently, and it sits at the centre of the integrated, automated airport direction the firm has announced, so management will stay committed to it and treat any slow early uptake as temporary in a long-cycle airport market.

The air situation display builds on the established tower offer and supports the announced real-time information sharing and collaborative decision-making strategy, so the firm's sunk development investment and public commitment favour keeping it despite little evidence of results yet.
